learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to know and differentiate between different types of scientific work.
Understand the structure and composition of scientific work and be able to transfer it to specific topics.
Understand and apply the principles of scientific work.
Know and apply methods for literature research and for creating a structured literature review.
Develop the structure and composition of presentations.
Know and apply principles of slide design and templates.
Successfully deal with disruptions during the presentation.
Constructively criticize other scientific contributions / presentations.

syllabus_topics: Time management when creating a scientific paper
Writing a scientific paper (e.g., requirements, components of a scientific paper, formal rules, correct citation)
Preparation and design of a presentation
Selection and development of suitable presentation materials
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination. The grade's weight for the final grade is determined by the credit points.
